title: Mitteler Rebbe's Padah Beshalom שערי תשובה ד"ה פדה בשלום part 2/6 (פרק ב-ג)
blurb: Link to מאמר PDF: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bl4prP_4LXDEjRICVXlZsmYLg-Dd9Dx7/view?usp=sharing Continuing in the מאמר, the מיטעלער רבי explains the scenario of war during Davening - when the נפש האלקית engages the נפש הבהמית and attempts to win it over to serve Hashem. We explain what exactly that means, and what that looks like - how will a נפש הבהמית want to serve Hashem? When that happens, the נפש הבהמית responds with its power of מחשבות זרות, and the מיטעלער רבי explains at length what these מחשבות זרות are, and what they do.

title: New Sefer Explores the Alter Rebbe on Hilchos Ribis
